articles.title: Senate won't vote on crypto Clarity Act before its summer break
articles.snippet: The U.S. Senate won't go on its August recess just yet but it will not vote on the Clarity Act this month, dimming hopes that the bill can become law this year.

articles.title: 10 weirdest things ever tokenized... including farts
articles.snippet: Tokenized cows may have gone viral, but they’re just the latest in a long line of strange things to find a home onchain, from farts, to human skin and destroyed artworks

articles.title: Bitcoin Wallet Dormant Since 2011 Moves Millions in BTC
articles.snippet: A Bitcoin address that had stayed silent for 15 years just sent its coins out for the first time.
